question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Cut me dead**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Ignored me deliberately**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Cut me dead"** means to deliberately ignore someone or pretend not to see them. (जानबूझकर अनदेखा करना) • **Example:** Even though we crossed paths, she cut me dead as if I didn’t exist. • **Ignored me deliberately** implies an intentional act of disregard or avoidance, which aligns with the meaning of the idiom "Cut me dead." (जानबूझकर अनदेखा करना) • **Example:** After our argument, he ignored me deliberately at the party. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Ignored me deliberately**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: Insulted me openly** (मुझे खुले तौर पर अपमानित किया) – Refers to making offensive or disparaging remarks in public. • **Example:** He insulted me openly during the meeting by criticizing my ideas harshly. • **Option 3: Misunderstood me accidentally** (मुझे गलती से गलत समझ लिया) – Indicates unintentionally interpreting something incorrectly. • **Example:** She misunderstood me accidentally when I said I couldn’t attend the event. • **Option 4: Praised me sarcastically** (मेरा व्यंग्यात्मक तरीके से प्रशंसा की) – Means using irony to mock or convey contempt while pretending to compliment. • **Example:** He praised me sarcastically by saying, “Great job on missing the deadline!” 3a:T6a1, The correct answer is** option 1.**
